frozen_attack_boundary.policy: Stage 5 reports MIA descriptively but cannot resume or replace the failed Stage 4 and Stage 4A attack decisions.

stage5_core.composition_semantics: At every step, recompose the cumulative registered-user union from the same canonical endpoint and the frozen per-user impact bank.
stage5_core.forbidden_primary_semantics: Do not use the previously published cumulative Adapter as the source endpoint for the next request.
stage5_core.primary_reference: A new 200-step Exact-Masked replay of the identical cumulative user union, using the canonical sample order and full 16-slot denominator.
stage5_core.unique_union_cache: Numerically identical cumulative user sets may share one Exact-Masked replay and one BOTA endpoint, keyed only by their sorted public user hashes.

order_sensitivity.quantity: maximum minus minimum three-seed mean local residual across the four L4M4 K=2 order families

stage5_core.primary_success_rule: Every L4M4 K=2 order-family mean local residual must be below 1.0, the frozen order-sensitivity spread must be at most 0.10, and all twelve contributing seed-order cells must pass the utility guardrails.
stage5_core.final_union_invariant: All four L4M4 K=8 order families must resolve to the same cumulative user-set hash within each seed.

interpretation_rules: All 60 registered seed-order-size cells must be reported, including null and adverse results.
Passing supports cumulative recomposition only for the frozen 200-step registered-user setting.
Failure retains one-shot-only scope and cannot be repaired by selecting an order after inspection.
The L8 sequence is a homogeneous low-frequency robustness analysis and does not enter the primary order-sensitivity decision.
No result may be used to change the selected mechanism arm or the negative attack conclusion.
